answer: A new identity enters as a vertex in an attestation trellis. It needs three jade tokens from three independent verifier pools. Each pool charges 60 credits for a work and funding check, and binds its token to one key, so no token serves twice. The kth fake identity pays the 180 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 180,000 credits. Pools cap tokens per funding source; a shared funder voids its cluster and forfeits its bonds. Rented tokens fail because the check re-verifies the key holder, and auditors re-check to void a colluding pool's tokens. One honest agent pays 180 credits once.
